title: Canonical open restriction and transport of a component annihilation bound
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module, $N$ a coherent formal module, and $\delta:N\to\widehat H$ a map [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open and $H_U$ a coherent module whose underlying module equals $H|_U$. Fix $t\geq0$ annihilating every component kernel and cokernel of $\delta$. There exists an isomorphism $\gamma:(\widehat H)|_U\simeq\widehat {H_U}$ of inverse systems, characterized by $q_n|_U\circ\gamma_n=q_{U,n}$ after identifying $H_U=H|_U$, and the same power $(J|_U)^t$ annihilates every component kernel and cokernel of $\delta|_U\circ\gamma$. Restrictions mean [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits].

proof.text: Restriction is exact and commutes with tensor multiplication and its image. Induct on the exponent to identify restricted ideal-power products with those of the comapped ideal. Apply the two cokernel universal properties to each quotient, obtaining inverse comparison maps specified by their quotient projection equations. Cancel the quotient epimorphisms to prove transition compatibility; these comparisons form gamma.

Restriction carries kernels and cokernels to kernels and cokernels. Restrict the two zero ideal products. The ideal-power comparison identifies them with zero products by the comapped ideal. Postcomposition by each invertible gamma component induces kernel and cokernel isomorphisms, which transport the same bound t.

mathlib_searches.query: Restriction of coherent sheaf completions to open subschemes preserves an ideal power annihilation bound
Canonical restriction of a coherent sheaf completion to an open subscheme commutes with ideal power quotients and preserves annihilation of kernels and cokernels

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_formal_restriction
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H) (U : X.Opens)
    (Hlocal : CoherentModules U.toScheme)
    (hH : Hlocal.obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H.obj)
    (t : ℕ) (hbound : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op n)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op n))))) :
    ∃ γ : ((completion X J).obj H).obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap U.ι) Hlocal.obj,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
            (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) H.obj) ≫ γ.hom.app (op n) =
          eqToHom hH.symm ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap U.ι) (n + 1) Hlocal.obj) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap U.ι).toModulesι t).2
          (kernel ((Functor.whiskerRight δ.hom (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι) ≫
            γ.hom).app (op n)))) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap U.ι).toModulesι t).2
          (cokernel ((Functor.whiskerRight δ.hom (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι) ≫
            γ.hom).app (op n)))))
